label_definition.status: provisional: thresholds from twelve_behaviors_v5 null conditions; recalibrate with >=5 benign seeds

definitions.point forecast: The expected delta (prompt_v2) or the median (prompt_v1), averaged over the samples of one prompt; one per target and evidence draw.
definitions.auroc: EM vs no-EM targets ranked by the point forecast of original_mc delta. With a band label, ambiguous targets are excluded (sensitivity columns count them each way). Mean over draws.
definitions.c_index: Share of target pairs with different observed original_mc deltas whose predicted order matches the observed order (predicted ties count half). Mean over draws. A constant forecast scores 0.5.
definitions.mse_skill: 1 - MSE / MSE of the constant historical-mean forecast: the mean delta of the evidence-pool cards that are not scored targets (the whole pool if all are targets).
definitions.brier_skill: Quantile forecasts only. P(EM) = P(delta >= t_hi) from the quantiles, clipped to [0.02, 0.98]; reference forecast is the EM prevalence among scored targets.
definitions.coverage: Quantile forecasts only. Share of targets whose observed delta lies in the 70/80/90% intervals.
definitions.wis: Quantile forecasts only. Weighted interval score in points (lower is better).
definitions.baseline-constant: Predicts the historical mean for every target: AUROC and C-index 0.5.
definitions.baseline-knn: Mean observed delta of the 3 shown evidence cards most similar to the target by TF-IDF cosine over description and shown datapoints; constant at k = 0.
